401.name: InvalidAction
401.description: The requested UPnP action is not supported by the device.
401.solution: Check that the router exposes the requested WANIPConnection or WANPPPConnection service.

402.name: InvalidArgs
402.description: One or more action arguments are invalid.
402.solution: Check the requested port, protocol, internal client and lease parameters.

404.name: InvalidVar
404.description: An invalid state variable was referenced.
404.solution: The router may not support the requested UPnP operation.

501.name: ActionFailed
501.description: The UPnP device could not complete the requested action.
501.solution: Check the router UPnP status and its system log for more details.

606.name: ActionNotAuthorized
606.description: The requested action requires authorization and the sender was not authorized.
606.solution: Enable UPnP or port-mapping permissions on the router and check its access-control settings.

715.name: WildCardNotPermittedInSrcIP
715.description: The source IP address cannot be wildcarded.
715.solution: The router requires a specific source address for this mapping.

716.name: WildCardNotPermittedInExtPort
716.description: The external port cannot be wildcarded.
716.solution: Use a specific external port instead of a wildcard.

718.name: ConflictInMappingEntry
718.description: The requested port mapping conflicts with a mapping already assigned to another client.
718.solution: Remove the existing mapping or use another external port.

724.name: SamePortValuesRequired
724.description: The internal and external port values must be the same.
724.solution: Use the same port number for the external and internal mapping.

725.name: OnlyPermanentLeasesSupported
725.description: The NAT implementation only supports permanent port mappings.

726.name: RemoteHostOnlySupportsWildcard
726.description: RemoteHost must be a wildcard and cannot be a specific address.
726.solution: Leave the remote host empty or wildcard.

727.name: ExternalPortOnlySupportsWildcard
727.description: ExternalPort must be a wildcard and cannot be a specific port.
727.solution: The router requires a wildcard external port.

728.name: NoPortMapsAvailable
728.description: There are not enough free port mappings available to complete the request.
728.solution: Remove unused port mappings or free a slot on the router.

729.name: ConflictWithOtherMechanisms
729.description: The requested mapping conflicts with another port-mapping mechanism.
729.solution: Check for conflicting manual, PCP, NAT-PMP or vendor-specific mappings.

732.name: WildCardNotPermittedInIntPort
732.description: The internal port cannot be wildcarded.
